קט.ja: אלגד'א אלמכין, ולא יזאל ינמו ויכבר חתי יקוי עלי אלחרכה ואלתקלב מע תמכנה מן גד'איה בגיר משקה ולא כלפה,
קט.en: with the well-prepared nutriment. He never ceases growing and increasing until he has the strength to move and turn, with his nourishment ready to him without effort or trouble;

pairs.en: He never ceases growing and increasing
until he has the strength to move and turn
with his nourishment ready to him

קט.ja: קד היי לה חית' לא ימכן לאחד מן אלבשריין איצאלה אליה בסבב מן אלאסבאב,
קט.en: for it has been prepared in such a place that no one of the human beings can arrive at conveying it to him by any of the means.

pairs.en: no one of the human beings
can arrive at conveying it to him

קט.ja: פכל מא זאד נמו ג'סמה תקוי גד'אוה אלי מדה מחדודה,
קט.en: Whenever the growth of his body increases, his nourishment grows in strength accordingly — until a fixed term.

pairs.en: Whenever the growth of his body increases
his nourishment grows in strength accordingly

קט.ja: ת'ם יכ'רג' מן בטן אמה עלי אצ'יק טריק מן גיר חילה יתחיל בהא עלי אכ'ראג'ה ולא לטף יסתעמל פיה לתסהיל ד'לך עליה,
קט.en: Then he comes forth from his mother's womb through the narrowest of paths, with no contrivance contrived for his being brought out, no kindly maneuvering used upon him to ease that for him —

pairs.en: no kindly maneuvering used upon him

קט.ja: בל בקדרהֵ אלחכים אללטיף אלראוף עלי עבאדה,
קט.en: but only by the power of the One who is wise and gentle, the One who is pitying toward His servants —

pairs.en: of the One who is wise and gentle
the One who is pitying toward His servants

קט.ja: כמא קאל אללה לאיוב ען בעץ' אלחיואן גיר אלנאטק הידעת עת לדת יעלי סלע חולל אילות תשמור, תספר ירחים תמלאנה וידעת עת לדתנה.
קט.en: as God said to Job about some of the non-rational animals: "Do you know the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? Do you watch the calving of the hinds? Can you number the months that they fulfill? And do you know the time when they bring forth?" (Job 39:1–2).

pairs.en: about some of the non-rational animals
Do you know the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth
Do you watch the calving of the hinds
Can you number the months that they fulfill
And do you know the time when they bring forth

קט.ja: ת'ם יחצל אלטפל פי הד'א אלעאם והו צ'עיף אלחואס, אלא חאסהֵ אלד'וק ואללמס,
קט.en: Then the infant is delivered into this world weak of senses — save the senses of taste and touch —

pairs.en: save the senses of taste and touch

קט.ja: ת'ם יהיי לה אלכ'אלק תעאלי גד'א פי ת'דיי אמה,
קט.en: and the Creator (exalted be He) prepares for him nutriment in his mother's breasts.

pairs.en: and the Creator (exalted be He) prepares for him

קט.ja: פינקלב אלדם אלד'י כאן גד'אוה פי בטן אמה לבנא פי ת'דייהא סאילא סאיגא עד'בא כאלעין אלנאבעה ענד אלחאג'ה אליה,
קט.en: The blood that was his food in his mother's belly is changed into milk in her breasts, flowing, sweet to drink, like a flowing spring at the hour of his need —

pairs.ja: אלד'י כאן גד'אוה פי בטן אמה
pairs.en: his food in his mother's belly
is changed into milk in her breasts
at the hour of his need

קט.ja: ליס בכת'יר פית'קל עלי אמה חמלה ויסיל מן גיר מץ, ולא קליל פישקי אלטפל ענד אסתכ'ראג'ה ואמתצאצה מן אלת'רי.
קט.en: not too much, lest it become a burden on his mother, flowing without his sucking; nor too little, lest it cause the infant misery in extracting and sucking it from the breast.

pairs.en: lest it become a burden on his mother
lest it cause the infant misery

קט.ja: ומן אללטף פי ד'לך אן צייר אללה תעאלי ת'קב אלת'די עלי מת'ל גרזהֵ אלאברה אלדקיקה,
קט.en: And among the subtleties in this: that God (exalted be He) made the bore of the breast like the puncture of a fine needle —

pairs.en: And among the subtleties in this
like the puncture of a fine needle

קט.ja: לא ואסעא פיסיל מן גיר מץ או יגץ בה אלטפל ענד מצה ללת'די, ולא צ'יקא אכת'ר מן ד'לך פיצעב אסתכ'ראג'ה עלי אלטפל באלמץ.
קט.en: not wide, so that it might flow without his sucking, or choke the infant when he sucks at the breast; nor narrower than this, so that its extraction be difficult for the infant by sucking.

pairs.en: so that it might flow without his sucking
when he sucks at the breast
so that its extraction be difficult for the infant by sucking

קט.ja: ת'ם יקוי ג'סמה פיבצר אלאלואן ויסמע אלאצואת,
קט.en: Then his body grows strong, so that he sees the colors and hears the sounds,

pairs.en: so that he sees the colors

קט.ja: פילקי אללה אלראפה ואלרחמה פי קלוב ואלדיה חתי יסתסהלאן תרביתה ויות'ראנה עלי אנפסהמא באלטעאם ואלשראב,
קט.en: and God casts tenderness and mercy into the hearts of his parents, so that they find his rearing easy and prefer him over themselves in food and drink,

pairs.en: into the hearts of his parents
so that they find his rearing easy

קט.ja: ותכ'ף עליהמא כלפהֵ ומשקהֵ תרביתה מן גסלה ותנט'יפה ואלתלטף בה ודפע אלאפאת ענה עלי כרה מן אלטפל.
קט.en: and the trouble and toil of his rearing become light upon them — his washing, his cleansing, the gentle handling of him, and the warding off of injuries from him, despite the infant's reluctance.

pairs.en: the trouble and toil of his rearing
and the warding off of injuries from him

קט.ja: ת'ם ינתקל מן מרתבהֵ אלטפוליה אלי מרתבהֵ אלצבא, פלא יכרה בה אבואה ולא יקנטאן בכת'רהֵ דואעיה וקלהֵ תמייזה עמא
קט.en: Then he passes from the rank of infancy to the rank of boyhood, and his parents are not wearied by him, nor do they despair at the abundance of his demands and the smallness of his discernment of what

pairs.en: and his parents are not wearied by him
at the abundance of his demands
and the smallness of his discernment
